'''2002 World Championship Top 8 Brian Rippetoe LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brian Rippetoe]] at [[2002 World Championship]] (Top 8), finishing 7th; the list below is from the official Players Committee decklist form.<ref name="src">[http://www.theforce.net/ccg/sw/decks/rippetoeLS.pdf SWCCG Players Committee decklist form: Throne Room Mains]</ref>

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Brian Rippetoe]]
* '''Event:''' [[2002 World Championship]]
* '''Stage:''' Top 8
* '''Finish:''' 7th
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassithroneroom.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Throne Room Mains
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Source:''' [http://www.theforce.net/ccg/sw/decks/rippetoeLS.pdf PC decklist form]
